name: Pact Magic Effigy
body:
You may create relics that allow you to harness spirits.

Benefit: You treat your occultist level as your caster level when determining if you qualify for magic item creation feats. This binder secret does not remove the increase to crafting DC (if any) associated with being unable to meet an item’s crafting prerequisites, such as spells known.

Pact Magic Unbound, Vol. 1. ©, 2012, Radiance House. Author(s): Alexander Augunas, Dario Nardi
